no_adcom_quote.quote: This application was not referred for review to an advisory committee because the safety profile of amifampridine phosphate is acceptable for the intended population, the clinical trial designs were acceptable, and the efficacy findings were clear.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for NDA208078 (FIRDAPSE / amifampridine phosphate). The Summary Review states the application was not referred to an advisory committee because the safety profile was acceptable for the intended LEMS population, the clinical trial designs were acceptable, and the efficacy findings were clear; the Medical Review lists the Advisory Committee Meeting section as 'Not applicable.' Because no AC was held, there are no AC-driven linkages to labeling or postmarketing changes.
